data.title: 一色彩羽 · 圣诞晚会后台的微醺红晕·「前辈……今晚可不可以只当我的圣诞老人呢」
data.description: 【联合圣诞晚会礼堂后台·雪夜】大获成功的圣诞活动幕后。彩羽头戴小红帽发箍，身上披着红色天鹅绒小斗篷，怀里抱着给你的特制礼物盒。在彩灯与幕布之间，她难得收起了小恶魔面具，眼中泛起真诚温润的水光，通红着脸将礼物递到你的怀里。
data.location: 礼堂后台幕布与彩灯旁
data.action: 手抱礼品盒微仰，红帽发箍披红色斗篷，真情告白泛红眼眸
data.lighting: 后台彩灯串五彩斑斓光芒与雪夜窗外幽蓝
data.camera: medium shot, christmas cape, holding gift box, backstage lights, sincere blush
data.promptProse: In the quiet auditorium wings, Iroha Isshiki holds a wrapped gift against her chest before offering it with a trembling sincere smile. A red velvet capelet overlays her buttoned navy executive blazer, left armband and white shirt; the pleated skirt remains neat. The medium view includes stage curtains and the snowy window beyond. Colored backstage fairy lights warm her tearful eyes and wrapping, while blue night outside outlines the cape's white trim.
